title: Distinguish normalized feedback preparations from open-loop discards
statement: A persistent nondemolition bit retains its original mixture under normalized almost-sure feedback/stopping and full record discard, while raw selective states have rank two. The maximally mixed XYZ illustration only obstructs open-loop nonselective words; feedback can change its discarded state. Paid restart/heralding is separately allowed access.

requires: Stationary finite native action/outcome library and repeatable independent full-process starts
assumptions: No universal impossibility of paid normalized preparation
Classical special case, not a quantum advantage
costs: All failed prefixes are charged starts; pool at most (1+s)(sum_(l=0)^(d^2-1) s^l)^2 before deduplication
Trace-seeded native word length at most 2d^2-1 plus terminal implementation; arbitrary inverse conditioning, minors, exact algebraic search, synthesis and planning paid
